**Subject:** 1:1 this week to discuss recent performance concerns

Hi Alex,

I’d like to set up a 1:1 this week to talk directly about some performance concerns I’ve seen over the past quarter. I want to be clear about the purpose of the meeting so it doesn’t come as a surprise.

A few specific examples I’d like to discuss:

- The Persona V3 integration was due March 15 and shipped March 28.
- The evaluation pipeline was due April 1 and is still not complete.
- I’ve received feedback that some recent code reviews on complex PRs have been very light, including one-line “LGTM” comments without substantive feedback.
- You also missed two team standups without notice, and there have been multiple times when you were unresponsive on Teams for 3+ hours during the workday without communication.

I also want to acknowledge that this is not the full picture of your contributions. Last year, you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored two junior engineers, and earned an Exceeds rating. Because of that track record, I want to understand whether something has changed and what may be affecting your work.

My goal for this conversation is to hear your perspective, understand any blockers or issues, and agree on clear expectations and next steps around delivery, code review quality, and communication. This is meant to be a support and course-correction conversation, not a punishment.

I’ll send a calendar invite for [day/time]. If that doesn’t work, please send me another time this week.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]
